rtl_result.summary: Implemented the single-entry elastic unsigned 8-bit registered adder.

files.purpose: Top-level handshakes, exact addition, output storage, backpressure, and synchronous reset.

contract_checks.evidence: Both packed 8-bit operands are explicitly zero-extended to 9 bits before addition.
out_valid tracks occupancy; simultaneous output consumption and input acceptance replaces the payload atomically.
When out_valid is high and out_ready is low, in_ready is low and neither output register is assigned.
Reset is sampled only in always_ff at posedge clk, has priority, and clears output valid and payload; combinational in_ready is low while rst_n is low.
Exactly one parameterless u8_registered_adder module is emitted with the declared ports and widths.

known_risks: No compiler, simulation, or synthesis tool was run as part of this generation.
